title: Adding a language moves every fixed text to scoped keys
why: The first extra language turns texts, attributes, SEO titles and string literals into view-scoped keys; <ErrorState> reads its texts from the dictionary.
changelog: Adding the first extra language moves every fixed text to keys
steps: If the app already has a second language, run `brain add locale <lang>` again on a branch and review the moved keys; add `error_state.*` keys to each dictionary.
